thread:
anna-finance: Sakura invoice INV-2026-0317 flagged 10.21% JP withholding. Vendor asking for gross-up. tagging @mike-tax @rachel-legal to confirm docs / approval. Invoice link: https://pay.redwood/inv/INV-2026-0317 :thinking_face:

sakura-payments: Hi all, confirming we applied 10.21% withholding at source. Per PO clause 4.2 we request Redwood to gross-up so vendor receives net amount. We'll upload Certificate of Tax Residence (CoTR) and a local tax agent letter. Do you need any particular Japanese tax form or is CoTR + agent letter OK?

mike-tax: FYI W-8 doesn't apply for JP vendors. We need a stamped CoTR (officially issued by Japanese tax authority or home country authority) plus an English translation. Also need vendor's Japanese TIN and a gross-up schedule showing net -> tax -> gross. @rachel-legal can you confirm whether legal will sign off on a gross-up addendum? Also confirm payment currency (JPY vs USD) because FX will affect gross-up math.

rachel-legal: We can only approve gross-up if we have: (1) signed gross-up addendum using our template, (2) stamped CoTR with translation, (3) written confirmation of why withholding applied (services, technical support, royalties, etc.). If any of those are missing we deny gross-up. Please upload scanned docs to secure link.

payments-bot: Invoice INV-2026-0317 received. Amount: 1,200,000 JPY. Due date: 2026-04-15. Current status: awaiting vendor tax docs.

anna-finance: Sakura please upload CoTR + signed addendum to https://files.redwood/upload (secure). Also include line-by-line gross-up calc: tax rate, tax withheld, gross total, beneficiary bank and SWIFT. We will put invoice on hold until docs come in.

sakura-payments: Done — I uploaded CoTR and signed addendum. Attached gross-up calc PDF: tax rate 10.21%, net payable 1,200,000 JPY, tax withheld 122,520 JPY, grossed-up total 1,322,520 JPY. Bank: MUFG Tokyo, SWIFT BOTKJPJT. We can provide an English translation of the CoTR and a scanned stamp.

mike-tax: Thanks. Two items: (1) Confirm whether the contract treats the fee as 'royalties' or 'business profits' — treaty treatment differs. If treaty reduces to 0% we shouldn't gross-up. (2) We need the actual CoTR stamp scan plus the vendor's Japanese tax ID. Also request a signed statement from vendor explaining withholding reason.

anna-finance: Marking the invoice "pending tax docs" in AP. No payments until we have the stamped CoTR and translation.

rachel-legal: I'll prepare our gross-up addendum template and circulate for signature as soon as we confirm the scanned docs. Note: if stamped CoTR can't be provided, legal will not approve gross-up.

anna-finance: Sakura please confirm stamped CoTR scan and translation by EOD Friday so we can proceed. If you need our template earlier I can share it.

sakura-payments: Understood — we'll get the stamped CoTR scan, English translation, and vendor TIN by EOD Friday. Thanks everyone!
